```{r}
# a visual look at the relative abundance after FMT
genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-genome),~./sum(.)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-genome, names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>% 
  left_join(., genome_metadata, by = join_by(genome == genome)) %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>% 
  filter(experiment_phase == "post-FMT") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=sample,y=count, fill=phylum, group=phylum)) + 
    geom_bar(stat="identity", colour="white", linewidth=0.1) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=phylum_colors) +
    facet_grid(~ experimental_group, scale="free", space="free")+
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
    theme(
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.6),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black")) +
   labs(fill="Phylum",y = "Relative abundance",x="samples")
```
```{r}
# G1 pre and post- FMT
genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-genome), ~ ./sum(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-genome, names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata, by = join_by(genome == genome)) %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(count > 0,
         experimental_group == "G1",
         experiment_phase %in% c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT")) %>%
  mutate(experiment_phase = factor(
    experiment_phase,
    levels = c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT")
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = count, fill = phylum, group = phylum)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
    facet_grid(~ experiment_phase, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.6),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = "solid",
        colour = "black"
      )
    ) +
    labs(fill = "Phylum", y = "Relative abundance", x = "Samples")
```

```{r}
plot_data <- alpha_div %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>% 
    filter(experimental_group == "G4",
         experiment_phase %in% c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT"))

ggplot(plot_data, 
      aes( x = experiment_phase, y = neutral )) + 
      geom_boxplot( alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA ) + 
      geom_jitter( width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7 ) + 
      #stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", paired = FALSE, p.adjust.method = "BH", label = "p.signif" ) + 
      theme_classic() + 
      labs( x = "Experimental Group", y = "Neutral diversity" )
```
### Beta div post FMT
```{r}
# Neutral beta diversity, q = 1
sample_metadata_FMT <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT"))

beta_q1n_FMT <- as.matrix(beta_q1n$q1S)

beta_q1n_FMT <- beta_q1n_FMT[
  rownames(beta_q1n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_FMT$EHI_number,
  colnames(beta_q1n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_FMT$EHI_number
]

beta_q1n_dis_FMT <- as.dist(beta_q1n_FMT)

sample_metadata_q1n_FMT <- sample_metadata_FMT %>%
  filter(EHI_number %in% labels(beta_q1n_dis_FMT)) %>%
  arrange(match(EHI_number, labels(beta_q1n_dis_FMT))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("EHI_number")

all(rownames(sample_metadata_q1n_FMT) == labels(beta_q1n_dis_FMT))

# check data structure
betadisper(beta_q1n_dis_FMT, sample_metadata_q1n_FMT$experimental_group) %>%
  permutest(pairwise = TRUE)


# Run adonis
adonis2(
  beta_q1n_dis_FMT ~ experimental_group,
  data = sample_metadata_q1n_FMT
)

# check again with adding the consideration of water temp
adonis2(
  beta_q1n_dis_FMT ~ experimental_group + scale(water_temp),
  data = sample_metadata_q1n_FMT,
  by = "margin"
)
```

```{r}
sample_metadata_FMT$sampling_date <- as.Date(sample_metadata_FMT$sampling_date)

# Convert distance matrix
beta_mat <- as.matrix(beta_q1n_FMT)

# Calculate centroid coordinates using PCoA
pcoa <- cmdscale(beta_q1n_FMT, eig = TRUE, k = 10)

coords <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)

coords$animal_ID <- sample_metadata_FMT$animal_ID
coords$experimental_group <- sample_metadata_FMT$experimental_group
```
```{r}
animal_coords <- coords %>%
  group_by(animal_ID, experimental_group) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("V"), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
```{r}
adonis2(
  dist(animal_coords[, grep("^V", names(animal_coords))]) ~ experimental_group,
  data = animal_coords,
  permutations = 999
)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)

pcoa_FMT <- wcmdscale(beta_q1n_FMT, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa_FMT$points[,1],
  PC2 = pcoa_FMT$points[,2],
  animal_ID = sample_metadata_FMT$animal_ID,
  experimental_group = sample_metadata_FMT$experimental_group,
  sampling_date = sample_metadata_FMT$sampling_date
)

var_explained <- round(
  100 * pcoa_FMT$eig / sum(pcoa_FMT$eig),
  1
)

ggplot(pcoa_df,
       aes(
         PC1,
         PC2,
         color = experimental_group,
         shape = experimental_group
       )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_explained[2], "%)")
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(pcoa_df %>%
    filter(experimental_group %in% c("G1", "G4")),
  aes(x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = experiment_phase,
    group = animal_ID,
    shape = experimental_group)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = experimental_group),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
# Calculate weighted PCoA using all samples
pcoa_FMT <- wcmdscale(beta_q1n_FMT, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa_FMT$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa_FMT$points[, 2],
  animal_ID = sample_metadata_FMT$animal_ID,
  experimental_group = sample_metadata_FMT$experimental_group,
  experiment_phase = sample_metadata_FMT$experiment_phase,
  sampling_date = sample_metadata_FMT$sampling_date
) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT")) %>%
  mutate(
    experiment_phase = factor(
      experiment_phase,
      levels = c("pre-ABX", "post-FMT")
    )
  )

# Percentage of variance explained
var_explained <- round(
  100 * pcoa_FMT$eig / sum(pcoa_FMT$eig[pcoa_FMT$eig > 0]),
  1
)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  pcoa_df,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = experiment_phase,
    shape = experimental_group
  )
) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = experimental_group),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "pre-ABX" = "red",
      "post-FMT" = "blue"
    ),
    name = "FMT status"
  ) +
  scale_shape_discrete(name = "Experimental group") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_explained[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```


```{r}
animal_centroids <- pcoa_df %>%
  group_by(animal_ID, experimental_group) %>%
  summarise(
    PC1 = mean(PC1),
    PC2 = mean(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(animal_centroids,
       aes(
         PC1,
         PC2,
         color = experimental_group
       )) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_classic()
```



```{r}
nmds_beta_FMT <- beta_q1n_dis_FMT %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(trymax = 500, k = 2, trace = 0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata_FMT, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase == "post-FMT") %>%
  group_by(experimental_group) %>%
  mutate(
    x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
nmds_beta_FMT %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = experimental_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
    alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "G1" = "blue",
    "G2" = "red",
    "G3" = "purple",
    "G4" = "green"
  )
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
